title: Error bridge and SLO-aware tracehook spec
creator: Asha Patel
description: Create a concrete spec and implementation plan for an "error bridge" that maps raw runtime and network signals (timeouts, overloaded worker backpressure, model runtime errors, HTTP/gRPC status codes, and inference rejections) into a normalized failure taxonomy, enriches traces via tracehooks, and surfaces SLO-aware views in dashboards. The goal is to provide one canonical dataset consumed by: (1) latency/error dashboards in Console, (2) alerting playbooks and SLI calculations, and (3) downstream analytics (cost/quality correlation). This ticket covers the spec, priority field mapping, sampling policy, instrumentation changes, and a phased rollout plan with migration of two example dashboards.
acceptance_criteria: A normalized failure taxonomy document is checked into docs/observability/error-taxonomy.md with categories: Timeout, Overload, ModelError, Rejection, NetworkError, ClientError (4xx), ServerError (5xx), Unknown.

Tracehook contract defined: fields to attach to spans (failure_code, failure_category, inference_variant, model_version, kv_cache_hit, upstream_latency_ms) and added to trace headers in 3 runtime entrypoints.

Telemetry pipeline mapping: logs and metrics transformation rules are submitted as a working patch to the pipeline repo (otel-transform rules) that converts vendor-specific codes into the failure taxonomy and emits a failure_reason tag in metrics series.
Two Console dashboards updated: Error Heatmap (by failure_category x model_version) and SLO Exposure panel (error rate by SLO bucket) using the canonical fields documented in the spec.
Rollout runbook created with: feature flag gating, dark-run sample of 5% traffic, canary metrics to validate parity, and rollback criteria defined (error delta > 0.5% or latency p95 shift > 10ms).
PR(s) linking runtime changes and pipeline rules are merged and pass end-to-end perf regression tests (no >3% QPS reduction in dedicated runner).
At least one oncall drill executed with the new dashboard and playbook and a short postmortem linked in the ticket comments.
Updated SLI definitions reference the new failure_category mappings for all relevant services.

comments: 2026-03-08 Asha Patel: Kicked off spec. Initial taxonomy proposal attached. I ran a quick grep across traces and found three distinct timeout patterns: socket timeout, handler deadline exceeded, and kv cache stall. Planning to unify to a single 'Timeout' category but preserve subtype in failure_reason.

2026-03-09 Miguel Santos: Drafted tracehook contract. Minimal fields to start: failure_category, failure_subtype, failure_code, model_id, model_variant, request_path, upstream_region, kv_cache_hit. Put proto in review at https://github.com/redwood-inference/tracehooks/pull/127

2026-03-10 Observability Infra (review): Suggest adding sample_rate and sampling_reason to tracehook to support low-overhead dark-run. Also proposed an OTEL transform rule example: if http.status_code >=500 then failure_category=ServerError.
2026-03-11 Asha Patel: Updated taxonomy doc with mapping table from runtime error strings and gRPC codes to categories. Uploaded doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OBS/Error+Taxonomy+Spec

2026-03-12 QA: Ran a synthetic load test against dedicated runner. Observed a 2% increase in trace size when adding full enrichment across 100% traffic; switching to 5% dark-run sampling reduces overhead to <0.1% latency delta. Recording results in the ticket.

2026-03-13 Miguel Santos: Opened PR to runtime: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/914 implementing tracehook attachment in the request path and guard via feature flag obs.error_bridge.enabled. Initial unit tests added.
2026-03-13 SRE: We need to ensure alerts that currently count 5xx errors don't double-count transformed entries. Added a dependency to update alert query ids in the alerting repo.

2026-03-14 Asha Patel: Drafted runbook and canary plan. Canary will run 5% traffic for 48h against staging, then 1% on prod dark-run for 24h, then increment if parity metrics stable. Rollback criteria listed.
2026-03-14 Miguel Santos: Marking 'In Progress' — starting implementation of pipeline OTEL transform rules and dashboard query templates. Next checkpoint 2026-03-18.
2026-03-14 SRE (note): Add dependency ENG-74321 (alerts migration) to avoid pager spam during rollout.
